scope: Read-only accrual NOI/per-item payments/working balances/proposed distributions audit of two existing T111 snapshots; no payout policy, annualization or personal capital classification

formulas.item_payment: accrued expense + opening payables - closing payables + closing prepaid - opening prepaid
formulas.operating_receipts: accrued income - noncash revenue - delta receivables + delta advance income
formulas.operating_payments: accrued expenses + property tax - noncash expense - delta payables + delta prepaid expenses
formulas.accrued_NOI: accrued income - accrued expenses excluding tax - property tax under supplied zero coefficient/floor guards
formulas.net_cash_minus_NOI: - noncash revenue + noncash expense - delta receivables + delta advance income + delta payables - delta prepaid expenses
formulas.free_cash_before_proposed_distribution: opening free cash + net operating cash + nonfinancing other receipts + reserve release + equity contribution - debt principal/interest/fees - capex - other cash payments - reserve deposit
formulas.closing_free_cash: free cash before proposed distribution - supplied proposed operating distribution
formulas.closing_restricted_cash: opening restricted cash + reserve deposit - reserve release
formulas.aggregation: sum period flows; retain first opening and last closing stocks; no sum of successive stock balances
